text: UNIQLO belongs to Fast Retailing Co., Ltd., a Tokyo-listed company built and run by Tadashi Yanai. At 28 February 2026 its largest shareholders were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (19.79%), Tadashi Yanai (15.85%) and Custody Bank of Japan (9.13%); Koji Yanai and Kazumi Yanai held 4.68% each.
